info.title: Sabz Zendegi API
info.description: REST API for Sabz Zendegi clinic services.

refreshCookie.name: __Host-sz_refresh
refreshCookie.description: HttpOnly refresh cookie. Local development uses sz_refresh_dev.

actorReference.description: Redacted actor reference; never a user identifier.

subjectReference.description: Redacted subject reference; never a patient identifier.

metadataSummary.description: Fixed safe summary, never raw audit metadata.

tombstone.description: Safe tombstone shown instead of restricted text.

checkpointCursor.description: Opaque checkpoint to persist after applying this page.

reporterNote.description: Optional non-sensitive note; never message or medical text.

requestImmediateBlock.description: Request an effective pending-review conversation-scoped block.

treatmentTaskId.description: Optional matching MEDICATION task in the same treatment plan.

amountRial.description: Integer rial amount, serialized without precision loss

assessmentReady.description: Account linking grants no medical-processing, payment entitlement or joint-result access

storeAvailable.description: Shopping is independent of medical onboarding

expectedRevision.description: Optional for legacy clients; protects a changing command from stale answers.
Optional for legacy clients; protects a changing command from stale answers.

body.description: Plain content; never execute untrusted HTML.

assessmentPurchaseId.description: Present for the ASSESSMENT target only

amountToman.description: Integer TOMAN; normalized Persian and Arabic digits accepted.
Integer TOMAN; normalized Persian and Arabic digits accepted.

assessmentPurchaseId.description: Present for the ASSESSMENT target only

amountRial.description: Exact integer IRR, including service-price remainders smaller than one TOMAN.

recipientPatientId.description: Existing self-profile routing address deliberately shared by the recipient; does not authenticate or grant consent

recipientPhone.description: Registered recipient mobile; normalized with the existing identity rules and never copied into invitation records

expiresAt.description: Always null: invitations have no automatic deadline

invitationToken.description: Returned only on first issuance; replay cannot recover the plaintext secret

weightKg.description: Decimal value serialized as a string.

body.description: Exact plain educational curriculum or professional service specification; never execute as HTML.

content.description: Approved content embedded on detail only; no provenance or approver identity.

discountCode.description: Optional commerce discount code; the server canonicalizes and prices it.

refundStatuses.description: Read-only refund lifecycle statuses for a verified order payment.

amountToman.description: Positive integer TOMAN for FIXED_AMOUNT only.

merchantId.description: Sadad merchant identifier issued to the clinic.

terminalId.description: Sadad terminal identifier issued to the clinic.

terminalKey.description: Sadad Base64 TripleDES terminal key; encrypted at rest and never returned.

credential.description: Write-only Sadad credential set; values are encrypted and never returned.

evidenceReference.description: Non-sensitive bank-transfer reference or evidence locator; required only when completing a refund

averageNetSpendToman.description: Integer-truncated TOMAN average; zero for an empty population.
